candidate_sentence_map.S1: During the financial year 2025, JLT Mobile Computers AB experienced strong commercial progress and sales growth despite a challenging external market environment characterized by geopolitical uncertainty and weak demand in its largest segment, warehousing and logistics.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Consolidated net sales for the full year 2025 rose by 11.1 percent to SEK 131.5 million, compared to SEK 118.4 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Order intake showed a robust increase of 37.5 percent, reaching SEK 141.6 million compared to SEK 103.0 million the previous year, supported by strategic deals including a major SEK 22 million order to an American food producer.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Despite top-line growth, profitability was heavily impacted by currency fluctuations.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: The US dollar lost nearly 20 percent against the Swedish krona during the year, while dollar-denominated sales accounted for 74 percent of total turnover.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Because invoicing occurred at a weaker dollar rate than when quotes were given and inventory was revalued at current purchase rates, the gross margin dropped by 7.5 percentage points to 38.3 percent, resulting in a gross profit of SEK 50.4 million compared to SEK 54.2 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: To counter market pressures and improve scalability, the company implemented structural cost-saving measures, including coordinating software development and discontinuing the subsidiary JLT Software Solutions AB, which reduced overhead costs by SEK 5 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Consequently, operating expenses decreased, and operating profit significantly strengthened to SEK -1.9 million from SEK -9.7 million the previous year, with the operating margin improving from -8.2 percent to -1.4 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: EBITDA similarly improved slightly to SEK -1.7 million from SEK -2.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Net financial items resulted in a profit before tax of SEK -1.8 million, compared to SEK -9.6 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: After tax, the net loss for the year narrowed to SEK -2.5 million from SEK -7.7 million, yielding earnings per share of SEK -0.09 compared to SEK -0.27 previously.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The company successfully focused on reducing pandemic-era safety stocks, lowering inventories by SEK 12.7 million to SEK 25.5 million at year-end, which enhanced capital efficiency and cash flow.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Cash flow from operating activities reached SEK 5.9 million, and total cash and cash equivalents increased to SEK 16.9 million from SEK 13.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The order backlog at the end of 2025 rose to SEK 24.1 million from SEK 13.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Market factors also included ongoing tariff and customs concerns, which increased administrative burdens and investigation costs, though Swedish-manufactured computers remained exempt from US export duties.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Operationally, JLT expanded its market focus into ports, construction, and mining equipment, and advanced its product portfolio by launching the JLT6015 15-inch Full HD rugged computer and an AI-powered screen blanking safety feature.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The Board of Directors proposed that no dividend be paid for the 2025 fiscal year, matching the previous year.

evaluation.label: Generally yes

K7 (geographical sales shift) and K8 (defense market project) are MISSING - no data on regional sales percentages or defense initiative costs appear in the candidate summary. The summary captures the majority of core material information (6 out of 8 criteria), but the absence of two MEDIUM importance items (K7 and K8) prevents achieving the 'Yes' (4) score, resulting in a 'Generally yes' (3) assessment.
